# The same key a file may not state, on the update path — a transaction named
# by `guid:` and re-imported under `--strategy update`.
#
# This is the half where a late refusal costs something: the edit destroys and
# rewrites splits, and a `lot_owner:` beside the bad key opens an owner lot
# that the transaction's rollback does not undo. Refused before any of that
# happens, the book is exactly as it was.
2026-04-01 * "Deposit carrying a note no file may write"
	guid: "TXN_GUID"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank 60.00 CAD
	Assets:Accounts Receivable -60.00 CAD
		lot_owner: customer:C-TWO-A
		orphaned_by_unpost: "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef"
